artifacts.summary: Added boxI_raise_step (lines 450-516): the single-node interpretation-raise step of Simpson's Lifting Lemma 8.1.3. Given raw-edge-cond rho, node x, raw R-neighbour n of x (either direction), and w >= rho x, produces rho' agreeing with rho off {x, n}, rho' x = w, re-establishing the x-n raw edge fact (F1 down / F2 up) and Gamma-cond persistence at n via ckforces_persistence. Sorry-free, axiom-clean.

memory_candidates: cs5FCIncest-model raise/interpretation lemmas over Label Atom need `classical` (not Function.update) to build an if-then-else re-interpretation function, because Function.update requires DecidableEq on the label type, which is not available for a generic Atom parameter. `Function.update_noteq` is not a real Mathlib lemma name; the correct one is `Function.update_of_ne` (note its argument/direction convention differs from the naive guess).

boxI_raise_step (Soundness.lean) is deliberately scoped to ONE raw-R-neighbour per invocation, not all of a node's neighbours simultaneously -- avoids an unresolved bidirectional-edge case (R x n and R n x both holding) that cs5FCIncest alone cannot discharge without an extra antisymmetry-style assumption. Phase 4.2 should invoke it once per tree edge during a traversal, not try to raise a whole neighbourhood in one call.
